newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: SOCCER-HOUGHTON OUT OF IRELAND SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HOUGHTON OUT OF IRELAND SQUAD.

text.p: Veteran midfielder Ray Houghton has pulled out of the Republic of Ireland squad for their World Cup qualifier in Macedonia on Wednesday.
Houghton, who won the last of his 67 caps against Liechtenstein at the start of this season's World Cup campaign, has just come back from a 12-week absence with groin trouble.
He played 90 minutes in Crystal Palace's 1-0 home defeat against Birmingham City on Saturday, missing two good chances in the closing stages.
Republic manager Mick McCarthy said: "Ray rang me after the game and said he was just not up to it at the moment. It was too soon after his recovery from injury, and I accept that.''
